title: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not properly validate the destination of the redirect performed when…
description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin versions before 9.4.0 contain a vulnerability where the plugin does not properly validate redirect destinations when a subscriber changes their list membership via a newsletter link. The validation only checks that the redirect URL begins with the site's URL, which can be exploited by unauthenticated attackers to redirect users to external sites that have URLs starting with the site's URL.
